name: Motion Format Bento
description: Dark 3-column motion feature set: a card with floating gradient app tiles, a purple hero card with a beating gradient heart inside orbit rings (a dot circling), and a right column of two folder-notch cards (browser icons; an accent 'Lottie' card). All artwork is token CSS/SVG.
interactions: cards fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-mfb-up, staggered 80ms)
left app tiles float: translateY +/-8px, 5.5s ease-in-out infinite, per-tile delay
center heart beats (wpmn-mfb-beat 2.4s: scale pulses on an off-beat) with a glow, while a dot orbits the rings (wpmn-mfb-spin 14s linear)
right cards use an SVG folder-notch silhouette (raised top-right tab), fill in the card/accent color
prefers-reduced-motion: float/beat/orbit off, reveals rendered in place
